title: Call Of Duty's April Fools Joke Brings The Franchise's Smallest Map And A Dead Meme
content: Call of Duty has featured famously small maps like Shipment before, but Black Ops 7 takes things further for April Fools' Day, adding a hilariously tiny map in a limited-time game mode. Developer Treyarch shared what looked like the layout of a small map on social media , and you can play on it right now.
